facts.claim: Green Flare's 53 MW Nigerian flare-gas project was publicly framed from announcement as a sequence rather than an endpoint: Bitcoin mining first because it is the fastest workload to deploy and monetise, then AI compute and cloud services on the same power.

sources.excerpt: With cheap, off-grid power secured, the company wants to expand into AI and machine learning infrastructure. Board chair Barbara Iyayi: "Whether it's Bitcoin, AI, or cloud, the world doesn't have enough compute."
sources.title: Green Flare turns Nigeria's waste gas into crypto mining power

sources.excerpt: The company may expand into related areas such as artificial intelligence computing and high-performance data centers.
sources.title: Green Flare Plans 53 MW of Flare Gas Bitcoin Mine in Nigeria

sources.excerpt: Green Flare's first three sites in Delta State will deliver a combined 53 MW of capacity. Its goal is to scale into AI compute and cloud services, offering low-cost power to global hyperscalers.
sources.title: Nigeria's Green Flare Turns Waste Gas Into Power for Bitcoin Mining

facts.claim: Green Flare announced a 53 MW flare-gas compute project in Nigeria in 2025, structured across three Delta State sites.

sources.excerpt: The initial phase of the project will establish three mining sites in Delta State, delivering a combined capacity of 53 MW.
sources.title: Green Flare Plans 53 MW of Flare Gas Bitcoin Mine in Nigeria

facts.claim: TeraWulf's first-quarter 2026 results, released 8 May 2026, reported $34.0 million of total revenue made up of $21.0 million in HPC lease revenue and $13.0 million in bitcoin-mining revenue, the first quarter in which contracted compute hosting outearned mining at the company.

sources.excerpt: Revenue of $34.0 million, including $21.0 million of HPC lease revenue and $13.0 million of digital asset revenue.
sources.title: TeraWulf Reports First Quarter 2026 Results (Form 8-K exhibit)

sources.excerpt: HPC lease revenue contributed $21.0 million in the period, representing the initial ramp of long-term customer agreements at Lake Mariner. We expect the business to be increasingly driven by recurring, contracted revenue, reducing exposure to the volatility historically associated with bitcoin mining.
sources.title: TeraWulf Reports First Quarter 2026 Results

sources.excerpt: HPC/AI hosting revenue of $21 million against under $13 million from bitcoin mining marks the first time HPC has overtaken Bitcoin as TeraWulf's primary revenue driver.
sources.title: TeraWulf's HPC revenue tops Bitcoin mining for first time as AI pivot accelerates
